snippet.title: Grimm: Quest for the Gatherer's Key (Part 1 / no commentary)
snippet.description:
Ten years ago, in 2013 I released Grimm:Quest for the Gatherer's Key. 

A total conversion for Doom 3. Since then I've seen a few streamers play it online, but never fully grasp, or experiment, with the underlying systems, weapon combinations and core gameplay mechanics. 

This playthrough is an attempt at preserving this game I made, hopefully making it 'the definitive' playthrough you will find online. Note this was played in 'normal' mode, which is the recommended way to play this mod. (Hard mode is only for veterans that have finished it at least once!)

It's still available on Moddb, but you will need the original version of Doom 3 to play it: https://www.moddb.com/mods/grimm-quest-for-the-gatherers-key

This was recorded using the latest version of Grimm, which was never released to the public, which includes voice overs and (a tiny bit) more lore exposure.

0:00 - Tutorial
4:20 - Introduction Cinematic
5:02 - Entering Purgatory / Start of Level 1
5:59 - Killing the hidden Creeper for bonus ammo
6:22 - Axe jump puzzle
10:20 - Gardens
12:15 - Bloodstaff / Lift down to the mines
16:19 - Tomb
19:07 - Deeper into the mines - 'aka. The Indy section' / Start of Level 2
20:17 - Killing the hidden Creeper for bonus weapon
23:54 - Four button Hallway Puzzle
29:47 - Four button Kitchen Puzzle
35:48 - Difficult button jump Puzzle
36:31 - Fiery Scythe Room
38:33 - Hidden Traps Room
